summary: Iteration 39 — Book-a-Venue nav CTA + SEO/sitemap enhancements verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 new tests PASS (sitemap.xml XML+urlset+17 static routes, cache-control at origin, robots.txt content, admin-only rebuild endpoint with 403 for HR, static file refresh). Regression: 27/27 iter38 CS-invoice tests still PASS. Frontend: Guest 'Book a venue' desktop button + mobile drawer button both navigate to /hire and close drawer. Guest /hire shows vm-guest-banner + vendor-type toggles + booking modal with vm-book-login-cta pointing to /login?next=%2Fhire (no vm-book-submit). Authed HR sees no guest-banner and 'Book a venue' remains in top nav. SEO: home, /events, /about, /contact, /sponsorships, /hire all update <title>, meta description, canonical, og:title, twitter:title correctly on route change AND restore on back-nav to /. index.html has full base meta (og:type, og:site_name, twitter:card, canonical, JSON-LD Organization schema). Static /sitemap.xml at root is served application/xml.

minor.issue: Cloudflare edge overrides Cache-Control from 'public, max-age=3600' to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Verified via curl direct to localhost:8001 that origin serves the correct header. Env-specific (preview CF quirk) — will not affect prod once kreedanation.com DNS/CF is configured. Same class of quirk as /robots.txt override noted in the review request.

integration_issues.issue: CorporateServices.jsx renders <SEO> only inside the authenticated HR/Organiser branch (line 65). Guest visitors (search-engine crawlers, unauth traffic) hit the login-Gate branch (line 43-51) which returns JSX WITHOUT <SEO>, so the page keeps the default index.html meta (title='Kreeda Nation — Where Teams Compete, Connect & Grow', canonical='https://kreedanation.com/'). Recommend hoisting <SEO title=... canonical='/corporate-services' /> above the gate return statements so crawlers see the right meta.

action_items: MINOR: Hoist <SEO> component above the auth-gate early-returns in /app/frontend/src/pages/CorporateServices.jsx so guests / crawlers also get the correct meta (currently they see the index.html default).
INFO: Cloudflare preview edge overrides Cache-Control on /api/sitemap.xml — env quirk only, no code change required (backend origin returns 'public, max-age=3600' correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: sitemap.py::build_sitemap_xml — clean XML build, escapes correctly, filters events/vendor_listings by approval_status + hidden/active, limits page-profile fetch to 5000 (safe). Uses _iso_date fallback that handles missing dates gracefully.

sitemap.py::write_static_snapshots + startup hook — snapshot file mtime updated on rebuild verified. Uses STATIC_DIR = /app/frontend/public which is inside the frontend build, so Cloudflare/ingress will serve /sitemap.xml directly from React public folder — the /sitemap.xml root URL currently returns application/xml (200). Good.
sitemap.py::rebuild endpoint — Depends(require_platform_admin) properly gates access, HR gets 403 verified. Response payload includes ok/sitemap_urls/base/written_at, per spec.

SEO.jsx — clean cleanup pattern that snapshots original head values on mount and restores on unmount. Verified back-nav from any sub-page restores home title/canonical exactly. No react-helmet dep needed. One nit: if two SEO components mount in overlap (parent+child), the child's cleanup could overwrite parent's set values — but current usage renders SEO once per top-level page so this is fine.

Nav.jsx — nav-book-venue-btn is a Button with onClick navigate('/hire') and hidden md:inline-flex — visible on desktop for both authed and guest. Mobile drawer has nav-mobile-book-venue with closeMobile()+navigate — verified drawer closes after click. Universal placement matches spec.

VendorMarket.jsx line 508 — canBook = user && (isPlayer||isCompanyAdmin||isOrganiser) toggles between vm-book-submit and vm-book-login-cta cleanly. Guest state shows helpful signup hint (vm-book-anon-hint) with 3 links. Great UX.

index.html — base meta populated with og:type/site_name/twitter:card + JSON-LD Organization schema. Canonical fallback is https://kreedanation.com/ which SEO.jsx overrides on mount with origin-relative path — works correctly in preview env (verified canonical becomes https://live-scoring-hub-5.preview.emergentagent.com/... via window.location.origin).
GAP: /corporate-services SEO only fires for authed HR — crawlers see default meta. Small issue but recommended fix noted in action_items.
